title: SO-1.01 Canonical execution integration: the store, the state machine and the coordinator as one authority
request: Closes G-SO-01 (addendum 2, review row 2; master baseline 3 and 8.2 name the integration as outstanding). Source: the Scope One addendum (PR #222, docs/scope-one/ADDENDUM-ARCHITECTURE-AND-DELIVERY-REVIEW.md at head a1757a0) and its review table (issuecomment-6534383323); owner request of 31 Oct 2026 that every aspect be decomposed in the WBS and built into contracts (t531u). The addendum names recommendations that become contracts on acceptance; this contract is the design-record stage, so it asks for the decision record and builds nothing. Contracts marked with a dagger are signed in the owner's vault and are not visible in this repository. Depends on contracts: SO-04-A, SO-07-A, SO-08-A, SO-08-B, SR-1.27.

tasks.title: Decision record
requirements: Make the project store the durable authority for project entities and append-only events.

Make the state machine and coordinator responsible for task lifecycle, claims, leases, generations, dependency-aware dispatch, resource selection, ownership, retries, recovery and execution scheduling.
Route state changes through the existing transition rules; adapters and UI code must not mutate authoritative state directly.
Define transaction and crash boundaries, idempotency keys, replay/recovery behaviour and schema migration rules.
Treat stale generations, expired leases, duplicate delivery and concurrent claims as normal adversarial test cases.

The record names the store schema
The record names the state-machine routes
The decision record passes the leak scan

stop_rules: If any criterion fails after the fix: STOP, report the measured result, the failing check and file:line. Do not start the next task.
